mil7.2.1:1.1: Mātikā samattā. Bhante Nāgasena, ghorassarassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. - Yathā mahārāja gadrabho nāma sankārakūṭe pi catukke pi singhāṭake pi gāmadvāre pi thusarāsimhi pi yattha katthaci sayati, na sayanabahulo hoti, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena tiṇasanthāre pi paṇṇasanthāre pi kaṭṭhamañcake pi chamāya pi yattha katthaci cammakhaṇḍaṃ pattharitvā yattha katthaci sayitabbaṃ, na sayanabahulena bhavitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja ghorassarassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena: Kaḷingarūpadhānā bhikkhave etarahi mama sāvakā viharanti appamattā ātāpino padhānasmin-ti. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā pi:
mil7.2.1:2.1: Pallankena nisinnassa jaṇṇukenābhivassati; alam-phāsuvihārāya pahitattassa bhikkhuno ti.
